text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 55 · 暖棕塔楼公共休息室.
Environment:  A round magic-academy tower common room, cream wool sofas, warm brown leather armchair, carved oak tables with closed books, small softly glowing hearth and broad Gothic window framing rolling hills. A few floating paper sheets without text, restrained magic. Pale stone walls, no portraits, statues, ghosts, coats of arms with animals or people. Warm high-key daylight dominates firelight.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit this contact sheet: remove panel C entirely because its stair is on the wrong side. Keep original A B D views unchanged, rearrange as three equal panels labeled A B C. Same architecture, furniture, lighting. No new objects, no people or animals.
